subject: English Home Language

source.topic: New life: Emergent Reading and Phonics
source.subtopic: Phonics: identifies the 'b' sound at the beginning of words and recognises the symbol 'b'

show.line: Listen. b as in baby. b, b, baby. Baby birds in the nest. b, b, bird!

rounds.prompt: Which one starts with b, as in baby?
Say the sound with me. b, as in baby!

rounds.story: A baby bird sits in the nest. Its mother brings a bug for breakfast. What does the mother bring?

rounds.prompt: Which baby animal starts with b? b, b.
What is this? It starts with b.
Does it start with b? Put b words in the b group.

hints: Listen for b at the start. b, b, baby.
Press your lips together and pop. b, b.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find a word that starts with b.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Egg starts with e. Baby starts with b.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's listen together. b, b, baby. Baby starts with b!

parent_line: Can hear the b sound at the start of words.
